featured_reviews.review_text:
Only a bookstore. Also this book store only caters to SCHOOL TEXTBOOKS. Many schools use their services to provide academic textbooks. We had purchased the academic years textbooks from the school. One of the textbooks had missing pages. In order to replace the book, we visited this store. Once I showed the missing pages to the person at the counter, he was kind enough to acknowledge the mistake. He didn't require the bill (which we had carried with us) and he replaced the book, no questions asked.
In this case, I am happy with the service.

The store is within a compound on the main street leading to 'Pumo House'. There is an opportunity to park a car outside the compound. If you are heading there on a motorcycle, you can park in side the compound. The store can be spotted from the street with any hassles.

featured_reviews.name: Mayank Jha
featured_reviews.review_text: Hands down the best bookstore in Mumbai. Been here a few times now, and I can say that the collection of books along with the quiet, peaceful atmosphere is unmatched anywhere else.

featured_reviews.name: Qurratulain Parihar
featured_reviews.review_text: My friend took me here for the 1st time today and I was amazed!! Even though it's a smaller book store, somehow there is an endless variety of books and so many different genres!! So many beautiful covers and attractive titles I saw today. All of them organized and aligned neatly. Its such a quiet & cozy little nook in the loud market of Andheri, I could spend hours in here. Needless to say I will come back to purchase books especially from the impressive children's selection for my little brother♡ It inspired me to start a collection of my own, my empty shelves are catching dust😅

featured_reviews.name: Supriya J
featured_reviews.review_text: This bookstore is my childhood... the reason why I am a book lover is because of Book Lovers! I recently visited after several years, and I got a huge hit of nostalgia, because it felt like nothing had changed (in the best way possible!). The store still has a wonderful collection of books, you could get lost there for hours.

featured_reviews.name: anirban bhattacharyya
featured_reviews.review_text: One of loveliest book stores of mumbai - tucked on the main road of Lokhandwala market it is the oldest one in mumbai perhaps

featured_reviews.name: Saket Gyani
featured_reviews.review_text:
One of the only surviving book stores in Bombay. My go to place for any book I want to read.
It’s a smallish shop (like most in Andheri) but they’ve managed to fill it with as many books possible.
You can get books from all genres here and can also order some books that they might not have in stock.
Places like this just take the cultural value of the neighbourhood up.

featured_reviews.name: Sachin Khot
featured_reviews.review_text: Been visiting here since 2001 & they have a wonderful collection and they can order for you if the book is not in stock... For a period of time I was in Jakarta & I used to order books from them & they used to courier the books to me.  Have a great relationship with Book Lovers at a time when the book shops are wanning in the city.  Over the years many of their staff has changed but whomsoever the new person he is courteous  & polite.... The owner Mani sir is available for a quick chat if you visit the shop & is a affable gentleman...

featured_reviews.name: Vaishnavi A
featured_reviews.review_text: I love the ambience of this book store and the staff is amazing too. They help us chose if needed and are polite. They also order books of your choice if necessary. It's an amazing experience all together. Would definitely recommend it to all book lovers ;)

I spent almost 2 hours to reach this outlet only to learn it's a godown in a very shabby condition. This place is basically used to store all the books in proper packing until the sale starts on different locations. Very few books on display to choose from rest are all cartoned up, and refused to be open. Definitely not visiting the place again. I'd suggest Fabiani art gallery at Irla and Sunderbai Hall in Churchgate are best locations with wide variety of books on display.
This place has no space for more than one person to browse at a given point.

All the books are not foe Rs 100 per kg but they have categorised it into Rs 100 and Rs 300, which I came to know when I visited the place. You can follow their sale at different locations in Mumbai by following their Facebook page 'books by weight'.

featured_reviews.review_text: Go to shop for new and used books. Krishna is always helpful and has a huge variety of hidden gems as well as bestsellers. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Ruchin Bhavsar
featured_reviews.review_text: Good collection of books. Reasonable priced new and used books. I would recommend this place!

featured_reviews.name: Surbhi Mukhija

featured_reviews.name: Vidhi Jain
featured_reviews.review_text: The man is sooo helpful. Show him the photos and he’ll guide you to the books instantly

featured_reviews.name: Esha Manwani
featured_reviews.review_text: Very good book store

featured_reviews.name: Liam Patel
featured_reviews.review_text: A hidden gem. The owner of Mind Gym Book Shop is incredibly kind, humble, and thoughtful, recommending books that perfectly match your taste. You can also donate books you no longer read, or return books purchased from him after reading and receive 50% of the purchase price back—a wonderful initiative for every book lover.

name: Kitaabghar Reading Room & Bookshop
description: We are quiet reading Room, bookshop & co-working space with weekly events and workshops. No conversations and calls permitted within the space to maintain a calm and cozy environment to accomplish focused reading and working. Ideal for readers, writers, freelancers or anyone who’s looking for a break from the city’s chaos.

featured_reviews.name: Megha Chand
featured_reviews.review_text: This place is a reader's (and the quiet worker's) oasis. The moment I enter this space, I forget about the city's chaos and surrender to all the vibes this place welcomes me with. Its a ghar away from ghar ❤️ Amal's sweet smile and welcoming demeanor makes this place all the more pleasant, you want to keep coming back for some me-time!

featured_reviews.name: zarin solanki
featured_reviews.review_text: If you're a book lover looking for some peace and calm, this place is a must-visit! The collection is incredible, with books from all sorts of authors and in different languages. It's the perfect spot to spend your day getting lost in a good read and soaking up some serious tranquility.

featured_reviews.name: Swapneel Rane
featured_reviews.review_text: Really love the collection books at Kitaabghar and always make it a point to pick a book at random and discover something new. Would highly recommend Kitaabghar to anyone who wants to spend a couple of hours being surrounded by books and an space to just enjoy reading a book in peace.

featured_reviews.name: CHINMAY MISHRA
featured_reviews.review_text:
Kitaabghar is like home for readers..
Cozy space,great interior design filled with posters and banners which inspire you to read more,coffee machine,and loads of books from different genres including,fiction,poetry,comics and what not..
Being an urdu poet,
The collection of hindi/urdu poetry which they have blew my mind..
You can get daily memberships and read as much as you want...
Definitely a must visit for readers..
💙💚💜

featured_reviews.name: Aparajita Singh
featured_reviews.review_text: A lovely bookshop with a sweet owner, I’m so glad to have finally visited this place during the last few months of my living in Mumbai, an absolute gem of a place, Events like board game sessions and workshops that happen are always worth attending, a place that I kept imagining and finding it similar to was  the hyunamdong bookshop which is a book by the same name “welcome to the hyunamdong bookshop” which i had bought from here itself on the recommendation of an employee that worked here, beautiful memories that I will cherish forever!

featured_reviews.name: Sidhant Mehra
featured_reviews.review_text: We just filmed the first episode of our new show at Kitaabghar and couldn't have asked for a cozier or more inspiring setting! ✨Thanks Amal!

featured_reviews.name: Everette Macy Colquette
featured_reviews.review_text: This bookstore is a must visit if you seek peace and quiet from the chaos of Mumbai! It was a lifesaver for me. Amal was so incredibly kind and visiting here will always remain a highlight from my trip to Mumbai.

featured_reviews.name: Prache Arshi
featured_reviews.review_text: Stumbled upon this adorable little bookstore "Kitaabghar Reading Room" and I'm still reeling from the experience! I attended a poetry session by Manav Kaul and the atmosphere was pure magic. The store's cozy nooks and crannies, lined with books, made me feel like I'd discovered a hidden gem. The session was intimate and engaging, with Manav's powerful words weaving a spell over the entire audience. I loved how the store's warm and welcoming vibe made me feel like I was part of a special community, if only for a few hours. Definitely going back for more!
